name: graph-rag
description: Answer a natural-language question that needs BOTH semantic retrieval and graph traversal through a running skardi-server: find the entities the question is about, expand from those seeds with cypher_query to collect the relationships that answer it, then synthesize with both halves cited. Encodes why this is two hops and not one query (cypher/columns are plan-time literals), the seeds-go-in-params rule, and the bounds a dense graph demands.
